name: read-signed
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,subprocess,sys,json
q=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/signed.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'sources/signed.txt'],input=q.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0;print(q.stdout)
